These were contribution-local violations. Finalization passing all three native lanes after removal also proved the generated legacy configuration placeholders were unnecessary.
local_review.finding_title: Generated tests violated metadata-generation and bounded-wait contracts
local_review.fix_note: Removed the task and generated resource wiring that wrote empty legacy Native Image configuration files. Added 10-second accept and socket-read timeouts to bound every loopback I/O wait while satisfying the minimum timeout rule. Re-ran the exact Forge review finalization command successfully; it made no further publishable change.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the target-only diff under the fixes-javac-fail skill and the contribution and test contracts. The repair correctly replaces the removed CompilerId.digest() API with makeRunFileDigest(JavaLanguageVersion, List<Path>) and supplies JavaLanguageVersion to walkDaemons while preserving assertions and native execution. Overall and resources dynamic-access coverage improve from 0/1 (0%) to 1/1 (100%), satisfying the ordered repair gate. Local index validation passed, and the authoritative finalization completed all three test lanes plus metadata, style, generated-test, and statistics checks without further publishable changes after the repairs. The repaired tree is approved.
